The '''Zalori system''' was located in the [[Hapan Rim Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Rim Route]] to the [[Rynmar system/Legends|Rynmar]] and [[Terephon system/Legends|Terephon systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zalori system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
